title: Service visit
description: One field visit written up by the service contractor who did the work, matching web/app/data-templates/serviceVisit.json. Dispatch lives in FieldForce (SYS-08), which has no link to the complaint system, so complaintId is carried here by hand and may be an empty string. POST /api/service-visits rejects a body that fails these rules, and /form/service-visit imports the same file to show errors before submit.
x-standards: IEC 61968 work management (WorkOrder, WorkTask, Activity) and MeterReading
ISO 8601 calendar dates and 24-hour clock times
ISO 10002:2018 for the complaint a visit answers
x-invariants: appointment.visitDate is on or after appointment.scheduledDate.
appointment.departureTime is later than appointment.arrivalTime on the same visit day.
charges.totalCharge equals labourCharge + partsCharge, rounded to cents.
charges.partsCharge is the sum of quantity times unitCost over parts.
When work.followUpRequired is true, work.followUpDate is a date on or after appointment.visitDate.
When meterRead.readingType is Not taken, both readings are 0.
A field meter visit is costed at 92.00 CAD and a smart meter installation at 148.00 CAD in northwind_unit_costs.csv; charges here are what the contractor billed, not that model.

accountId.title: Account
accountId.description: Account the premise is billed to. Form ACC- plus six digits, as on the account file.

complaintId.title: Complaint
complaintId.description: Complaint the visit answers, or an empty string for planned work with no case. Cases transferred between systems lose their history, so an engineer may arrive without one.

contractor.title: Contractor
contractor.description: Firm that was dispatched and the engineer who attended. IEC 61968 Crew and CrewMember.

contractorName.title: Contractor name
contractorName.description: Trading name of the service firm.

engineerId.title: Engineer
engineerId.description: Identifier of the attending engineer. Same EMP- form as a complaint assignee.

region.title: Region
region.description: Northwind operating region, as used by northwind_meter_reads.csv and the complaints extract.

appointment.title: Appointment
appointment.description: Slot the visit was booked for and the hours actually worked. Times are local 24-hour clock times, which is what a time input submits.

scheduledDate.title: Scheduled date
scheduledDate.description: Date the slot was booked for. A missed appointment is a regulated standard with a 40.00 CAD compensation payment.

work.title: Work done
work.description: What the contractor did and how the visit ended. IEC 61968 Activity plus the completion status.

systemId.title: Recorded in
systemId.description: Northwind system the write-up was entered into. SYS-08 is FieldForce, the scheduling and dispatch system. Codes come from northwind_systems.csv.

description.title: Work description
description.description: What the engineer found and did, in the contractor's words.
examples: Replaced the stuck water meter and took a closing read. Stopcock left accessible.

followUpRequired.title: Follow-up required
followUpRequired.description: True when another visit or an office action is still owed.

followUpDate.title: Follow-up date
followUpDate.description: Date the follow-up is booked for, or null when none is owed.

meterRead.title: Meter read
meterRead.description: Read taken at the visit. MeterHub (SYS-06) estimates when no read is returned, so Not taken is recorded explicitly rather than left blank. IEC 61968 MeterReading.

waterM3.title: Water reading
waterM3.description: Register reading in cubic metres (UCUM m3). Zero when no read was taken.

electricityKWh.title: Electricity reading
electricityKWh.description: Register reading in kilowatt-hours (UCUM kW.h). Zero when no read was taken.

charges.title: Charges
charges.description: What the contractor is billing Northwind for this visit, in Canadian dollars.

partsCharge.title: Parts charge
partsCharge.description: Sum of the parts lines below. Zero when nothing was fitted.

totalCharge.title: Total charge
totalCharge.description: Labour plus parts. Tax is settled on the contractor's own invoice and is not carried here.

parts.title: Parts fitted
parts.description: Parts used on the visit. An empty array when none were.

VisitId.title: Service visit identifier
VisitId.description: Identifier printed on the visit write-up. Form SV- plus six digits, parallel to ACC-, BILL-, and NW-.

ContractorId.title: Contractor identifier
ContractorId.description: Firm on the Northwind field services framework. Form CON- plus three to eight digits.

MeterId.title: Meter identifier
MeterId.description: Meter serial as held by MeterHub. Form MTR- plus eight digits.

SystemId.title: Northwind system
SystemId.description: System code from northwind_systems.csv, SYS-01 through SYS-15.

ClockTime.title: Local clock time
ClockTime.description: Local 24-hour time as hours and minutes, the value a time input submits. No seconds and no UTC offset: a visit is recorded in the region's own working day.
